> Hi, I've been working on this CL for phosphor-host-ipmid, and updated it to adapt to this change (https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-host-ipmid/+/68621). So is it right that I need to push a change to intel-ipmi-oem, too?

Yes. There might be other places, please double check. I only did one quick search.

I pushed a patch here: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/intel-ipmi-oem/+/76690 but the CI fails for some reason I don't think related to my change. I just updated to adapt the object path change, no functional change added because it's quite different how phosphor-host-ipmid and intel-ipmi-oem interpret "Chassis Intrusion" in "ipmitool chassis status". If an object path exists on D-Bus for chassis intrusion, intel updates the status to `active`, in contrast, ipmid use "Chassis Status" to represent the real intrusion status.
Yes, there might be an existing issue. I think the problem can be fixed by getting the Status value from the object
